entries.headline: President says he directed the military not to proceed without two approvals
entries.summary: In a November 23 post, President Trump said he directed the military not to proceed unless the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit and Iowa Governor-elect Rob Sand agree. The post gives no replacement date or time. November 25 remains the date in the last reviewed Army notice, not confirmation that the operation will go ahead.

entries.headline: Army moves the planned operation to November 25
entries.summary: The Army rescheduled from Monday, November 23, to Wednesday, November 25. Its announcement did not give an exact time.

entries.headline: Army postpones the operation to November 23
entries.summary: The Army postponed the operation previously planned for November 20. This notice was later superseded by the November 22 announcement.

entries.headline: Army announces the original November 20 plan
entries.summary: The Army’s public advisory listed November 20 at approximately noon. This date was superseded, and the time did not carry over to the new date.
